L: Hi everyone, welcome to my little apartment tour.
I live on the fourth floor with my parents and my little brother.
It's not big, but there's a balcony where my mom grows herbs.
Here's the living room. We eat, watch TV and do homework in this one space.
My brother and I share a bedroom, so it gets messy sometimes.
My parents moved here ten years ago, when I was six.
Before that, we used to live in a small town near the sea.
I miss it a little, but I love the city lights at night.
Anyway, thanks for watching! Leave a comment and tell me about your home.
